traits.name: Damage Immunities
traits.description: Immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The werewolf can use its action to polymorph into a wolf-humanoid hybrid or into a wolf, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies. (CONTENT_CONVENTIONS §58. True form: AC 11, walk 30, one spear attack. Hybrid: AC 12, bite and claws. Wolf: AC 12, walk 40, bite. Keen Hearing and Smell stays description-only. Can't speak in wolf form is not a speech rule.)

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The werewolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
traits.description: The werewolf makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws or spear.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Bite (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only). Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with werewolf lycanthropy. (The lycanthropy curse stays description-only. HOLD. No save is rolled.)

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Claws (Hybrid Form Only). Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Spear (Humanoid Form Only). Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Spear (two hands)
actions.description: Spear (Humanoid Form Only). Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Spear (thrown)
actions.description: Spear (Humanoid Form Only). Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.
